name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior natural resource company focused on acquiring mineral royalty interests and exploration earn-ins in Nevada's Walker Lane gold trend. Its primary focus is the Lapon Canyon Gold Project, where a 2025 RC drill program returned 3.79 g/t Au over 85 metres, and a maiden NI 43-101 resource is targeted for 2026. The company operates an asset-light model combining royalty creation, precious-metals streaming, and project acceleration across properties in Nevada and Idaho.
